narr: Regenerating morning convection anchored over eastern portions of Hamblen County and Morristown produced flash flooding.
ev: Several roads flooded and some barricaded. Flooded roadways included Slop Creek Road and Springdale Road. A bowl-shaped backyard was filled with water up to a trampoline surface. Video of stream flooding shared on social media.
Barkley Landing Drive was closed for flooding.
